escena: SCENE (a bare desk in a dark modern office at night, seen straight on at desk height): FIVE identical bezel-less display panels stand in a neat straight row across the desk, evenly spaced, clean and orderly — and FOUR of them are completely DARK and switched off, their glass black and reflective. Only the LAST panel on the right is still on, showing a rounded ANSWER CARD glowing on a dark field — a plain empty rounded rectangle with short bright underlines beneath it and nothing else: no letters, no numbers, no words, no icons, no interface chrome, and it is the only light in the entire frame. The row is not dismantled or messy: it is an orderly shutdown in progress. Standing on the desk directly in front of that single lit panel, small, the Gigi figure from the reference faces it, taking a last reading. The lit panel rakes hard light across the dark glass of the four switched-off panels, catching their edges. Everything else falls to deep navy black. Fine dust hangs in the light. The figure is the ONLY colour in the frame. 50mm at f/2.8, camera at desk height. NOTHING IN THIS SCENE MAY READ AS OLD OR ANALOGUE. Absolutely NO books, NO paper, NO plants, NO mugs, NO pencil cups, NO clutter anywhere in frame, including out of focus in the background. Every object is current-generation hardware with clean machined surfaces: anodised aluminium, matte glass, seamless edges. Screens are bezel-less, edge to edge. The desk is bare except for what the scene names. The room behind is empty architectural darkness, not a cosy study.

texto.muro: the empty dark office wall above the row of panels, unbroken and unlit

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the desk in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK near-black anodised aluminium in deep shadow, matte, outside the light
